summary: Static code review of Customer app permissions.tsx (Phase1 Auto + Phase2 Wizard). Ran tsc and eslint as per request. tsc has NO errors in app/permissions.tsx (only one unrelated pre-existing error in app/(customer)/subscriptions.tsx:322 regarding color index 900). eslint clean. Code adheres to all stated requirements with proper hook rules, ref-guarded one-shot Phase 1, ref-guarded auto-advance in Wizard, and safe finish paths.
critical_code_review_comments: Hook rules: useState/useEffect/useRef/useCallback used at top level in PermissionsScreen, AutoPhase, Wizard. OK.

Phase 1 one-shot: `started = useRef(false)` guards the useEffect even though `finish` is in deps; `finish` is useCallback([router]) and router from useRouter() is stable in expo-router, so no re-run risk. OK.
Stale closures: Wizard's `advanceIfGranted` useCallback deps include [key, idx, steps.length, onDone, setIdx]; AppState effect re-subscribes when it changes. OK.
Double navigation guard: `advanced = useRef<Key|null>(null)` with `advanced.current === key` check prevents double advance when both AppState 'active' and inline readAll-after-request fire. OK.

Unreachable finish: covered via (a) Phase1 → no wizard keys → finish(); (b) Wizard next() last step → onDone(); (c) advanceIfGranted last step → onDone(); (d) Skip button labelled 'Finish' on last step. OK.
Web platform: needsPermissionSetup() returns false on web (permissions.ts:66) so the screen is not shown. OK.
Infinite loop risk: Phase1 effect deps=[finish] + started.current guard → cannot re-enter. OK.
Minor: rapid double-tap of Skip/Finish could call router.replace twice; low impact since replace is idempotent for same route. Non-blocking.
Minor: WizardProps types `setS` and `setIdx` narrower than React Dispatch types; passing parent setters still assignable to narrower function types. OK (TS passes).
Pre-existing unrelated TS error (not from this change): app/(customer)/subscriptions.tsx:322 — PRIMARY[900] not in color map. Flag to main agent if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static review only (Expo native cannot run). tsc/eslint clean for app/permissions.tsx. One pre-existing unrelated TS error in subscriptions.tsx:322 (PRIMARY[900] missing).
